items.text: I hope you're all enjoying running in the summer heat, or the winter cold, depending on which part of the globe you're on.
I wanted to drop by to say hi, and coincidentally, the team also had an update they wanted me to tell you about!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"]
Since I've been on holiday, I don't know what's coming, so let's find out what's in this update...
Oh, that looks important.
Oh! That one looks *very* important!
Well, we should all celebrate that Endless saves have been fixed! (And forgive and forget that they were ever broken...... :grunt: )
Saves work in the Endless Shard again! (Finally I won't have to keep the game running for three days straight anymore!)
The Time Trial result Continue button is now selectable on a controller
Fixed settings tab sizes when changing languages
Fixed an issue where the name of the button would appear in some text in the intro tutorial rather than the actual button glyph
Fixed an issue where some other nonsense () would show up instead of a button glyph in the tutorial

Hopefully this results in a more stable experience for everyone. I'm gonna be seeking some stability myself in the next part of my vacation. One of my best friends suggested I try a silent retreat, so I will not be saying a single word for an entire week! Wish me luck!
Oh, what's this? I almost forgot to show off community art this time!
This beautiful art by Elliot
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/6ab265375dfacaadd907ad5bd5b11040847fdf76.png"]
OH NO ZOE!!! By Spark
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/39cef5c46c47ed125cf119219acb43cfb10e5787.png"]
Oh good, she's ok! By Da_best_kagyu
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/2be744eec38d81afa1402861c20306b272c35748.png"]
She really does! From radmirahmarov
That's it for me! Now I'm off to my silent retreat, and won't be uttering a single word! Starting now! Or later when I get there, I guess. This will be very exciting!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"]
Seems like a weeboh got into the code and caused the Collapse Speed to use the Obstacles difficulty setting instead.
That could make it very very fast!
We have also made it so that weebohs following you will be slightly less likely to get stuck staring down into the ground.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/ceb793aa960434799a867a5ebce0b667a0fe40bb.png"]
That's all!
Fixed Collapse Speed using the Obstacles difficulty setting instead of its own
Weebohs are slightly more balanced (but not very)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"]
All right, all right, I'll talk about the Time Trials as well. But the weebohs-
Okay! So, it's now possible to revisit previously played shards and do Time Trial runs through them. They are a little shorter than regular runs, but track your time.

There are two different modes, one where you run a predetermined seed for that Shard and try to get the best possible time, and one where you can enter any seed in an attempt to find the best possible seed.
Since the levels need to be the same, all Time Trial runs are set to Sprint difficulty.
Hopefully, this will lead to some interesting new ways to challenge yourself!
Now, over to the real headline feature of the update!
"Oh Riza, why are the weebohs just walking around? Riza, why can't we feed the weebohs??"
WELL GUESS WHAT!!!
I don't want to say too much, but weebohs will now react to your presence. If you have a hard time getting close, try bringing them a nut!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/9a4ddf107ca08253fcc8f35af5067f321fb30b14.png"]
Added Time Trials to every Shard with separate Set Seed and Custom Seed modes
Added more dynamic weeboh behaviour
Slightly reduced the wave height and wave damage for Jumper 3
Increased Jumper 3's "time before jumping" by 3%
Some fixes to the way the Marathon and Megamarathon achievements are tracked

As a final note before the community art, after almost a year of updates, this is the last content update the devs have planned for the game at this time. There will most likely be more patches with fixes as they're working on console ports, but after that, it's time for them to run off to other worlds - at least for now ❤️
Let's not pretend that Court Mandated Riza on the Discord doesn't know exactly how to get my attention. I would have made the team make an update just to post about this:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/1f9d418687df6fc0e0b18f257a844ffd0f3f026f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/e462adf7273a808312abc99c31018c0a8e9caad4.jpg"]
Today's theme is going to be different mediums, as Haste art continues its foray into the physical world with this piece from Semi:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/7e9a2fd758aff7d1f79a0a7de7d0a232c6dec2da.jpg"]
But it's mixed media in the digital world, too! Here's a poster made of... blocks?? Some crossover into a different digital world by Alliumchocolate.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/dd9a0e4f6d98721c65ad760c5c31c44342c2f4a2.png"]
And here comes a handful of very differently styled but very characterful Zoes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/9e20687b7cdfbcfc28a1a98a4f917aa6b2834fba.png"]By ejayfreekay
It's a real joy to see the different ways people interpret her:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/6f1dd87ada5e70451b9109c1ccdbb14802cd2fb1.jpg"]By ShanicMCA
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/3388016d765de9e4087ea9fbf7a30ec05bddcb12.jpg"]By Julidoodle
But in all of them, she has that twinkle in her eye, even when things get serious!
Thank you to all the artists out there giving us such beautiful interpretations of the worlds and characters!

items.text: As all things must, the year is soon coming to an end. However, that does not mean it has to be a time of dourness and darkness! Especially since another Haste update is here!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"]
The team is working on a slightly bigger update, but they wanted to get this out the door while they finish what they're cooking up.
In addition to the usual bug fixes, this update has a special focus on tweaks to the various User Interfaces in the game, which is what makes this the Wrapping Paper update!
However, first there is one gameplay change I need to address. All Cooldown Reduction items now reduce a percentage of Cooldowns (-X%), rather than absolute values (-X seconds).

Now, before you get your pitchforks out because we've ruined Atomic Timepiece synergies, this doesn't actually change much for how these items interact with items with short Cooldowns. However, it makes a huge difference for how they interact with items with long Cooldowns! It results in Cooldown Reduction items being a lot more useful than before, when they were reliant on getting one of a handful of extremely powerful synergies.

For the UI updates, we have worked hard to make them more accommodating to the variety of screen sizes and resolutions out there, as well as to make them overall nicer to look at. If we're being honest, some of them were put together in quite a slapdash fashion, and gradually built up as the game has kept evolving since release. This was a chance to improve the feel of the game in a lot of little, subtle ways.
Personally, I think it has resulted in a more pleasant experience, even if I don't spend much time thinking about it!
The Shard Settings view has received a significant overhaul, with a top-to-bottom look that makes it easier to parse:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/6d325cb6dfcfb129b180d5e3389c5793cb139bb2.jpg"]
The Fragment Descriptions and Disruption notifications now look more coherent with the rest of the game's aesthetics:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/a9d71c7e8820fa9ab5bfb29366a311a87b5b3a84.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/a7bd5d9004a9a4930d48757c919c64872e318729.jpg"]
A lot of other views have been adjusted, so play through and see if you notice a difference!
Cooldown Reduction Items now reduce a percentage of other items' total Cooldown, rather than absolute values.
Sparks now stay where they are supposed to in Boss Fragments again
The game no longer soft locks when completing a Shard without the UI enabled (oooops)
Having too many items will no longer make the pause screen inventory go off-screen
Item Tooltip cards can no longer go off-screen (a common problem on lower resolutions)
The version number on the main menu now stays anchored to the logo no matter the aspect ratio
Improved Steam Deck (and other small screen) UI sizing overall
Updated the Shard Settings view
Updated the Antisparks Upgrade view
Updated the All-Time Stats view
Updated the Unlocked Items view
Updated the Hungry Weeboh view
Updated the Multiplayer Invite window
Updated the multiplayer Player List
Updated the PostGameScreen view
Updated the Fragment Description view
Updated several notifications, including the Fragment Disruption notification
Of course as usual we have a selection of very cool Community Art to show off, too!

It's been a little while.
The plan was always for this to be a quiet month, with slow but steady work on the next update for Haste.
Well, someone should have told the dev team!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"]
Major item overhaul!
Rumble!
Disaster in Endless!
First of all this update brings a much-requested new feature for controller players - RUMBLE!
For a game like Haste it makes a lot of sense to feel as connected to the action as possible, and a little vibration in your controller goes a long way.
The most notable addition is probably the Running Rumble, a constant stream of intense little footsteps. It sounds like a joke, but give it a try!
There's of course settings to adjust the strength of the various different types of rumble in the game, and many different kinds of controllers, so experiment to find which style you prefer.
There's also a special setup for controllers that use "haptics", so if you're using one of those (SteamDeck and PS5 DualSense) you can look forward to some extra precise vibrations.
Then there are two more little things before we get to the big one:

notes.title: Disaster Mode is now playable in Endless!

items.text: Once you've unlocked a Disaster Mode, you can choose to equip it in your Endless run as well. You will get the effects and obstacle spawns caused by the Disaster Crowns, but the difficulty of the levels will still be decided by the Endless difficulty setting you use.
I'm not sure how many of you want to play Peaceful with Disaster Level 4, but the option now exists!

The slider for the Obstacle difficulty setting has been adjusted so it now goes up to 500%, even without mods! The actual difficulty presets remain at their old values, but this is a fun way to increase the challenge beyond the game's normal limits.
And finally we get to what is probably the most important change - the long-awaited item overhaul!
Here's a prepared statement the team has asked me to include:

"We have long been aware that the item economy has been very lopsided, with little rhyme or reason to item frequency or power. Some of the best items in the game were in the 'Common' rarity category, which under certain circumstances would be just as rare as 'Legendary' items, the highest rarity category. Our goal with this update is to adjust the rarity categories so the lower rarities are more useful, while the highest rarities feel exciting and powerful to come across. While thios change is going to make some extreme builds less common, it will hopefully create a much broader range of viable builds during runs, leading to much greater variety. The way we have gone about all this is by-"
Wow, this goes on for a while. Let me just skim it...

Okay, so veeery long story short, low-rarity items are now more frequent, high rarity less so, but a bunch of items have been given new (lower) rarities, and many items have been given improved effects.
Big changes like this are always scary, but it really makes the game more interesting and fun!

There's also a promise in here that this will not be the last set of item balance changes, so if you have feedback about the new system or about specific items, please let the team know, preferably through the Discord.
Oh before we get to the very long patch notes here's a video of INK creating the Hungry Weeboh!
Have a look at the full balance changes below.
Exciting times, huh?
RUMBLE! (Including a bunch of settings)
Disaster Mode is now playable in the Endless Shard
Increased maximum Obstacle difficulty setting
"Chance Items" with a percentage chance for something to happen now show the final Luck-modified value instead of just the base value (along with a tooltip with a breakdown of the calculation)
You now start with full Energy in the Hub World
New difficulty setting for Item Rarity, which multiplies the chance of getting higher-rarity items. (Defaults to 100% on all difficulty levels)
The post-run stat screen now shows your item loadout
Abilities can no longer be triggered while not running, which fixes a number of edge cases (mostly related to spending all your Energy while Zoe is off-screen)
Improved the way Boost Rings spawn from Items
Item effects that stack every time they are triggered (like Well Earned Confidence) now carry over between Fragments
Stacking triggered item effects now correctly get removed if you remove the item
You can no longer exploit the Reroll button in Endless multiplayer to get near infinite items (sorry!)
The UI for equipping skins now correctly opens with your currently equipped skins selected
Eliminated a momentary freeze when closing the Shard Setting menu
The Fragment Disruption tooltip for Research Outpost discounts is now correct
A number of Luck items were incorrectly multiplying each others effects
Added a message about why you cannot send items to another player if you are in an empty multiplayer session
Item Tooltips now shift to the left side of the Item description if there's no more space to the right on the screen
Hard and Very Hard Endless now start at slightly higher difficulty
Items granting +% of Max Health no longer multiply themselves (this is a much more intuitive behaviour in addition to being easier to balance)
Lower-rarity items are now more common, higher-rarity items less common
Shard difficulty and progress now has a bigger impact on the rarity of items you find, so higher-rarity items become more frequent the further you get in a Shard
Lots of items have had their Rarity adjusted
Some items now have an Item Cost Multiplier for their own price. This has been sparingly used and is not surfaced in-game, but is another lever for balance in the long run.

notes.title: Hi! I'm back with a tiny little update from the team for you.

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"]
The Flotation Device now has a more accurate tooltip, and its effect triggers for every 5 seconds spent in the air instead of every 3 seconds.
Made various fixes to the Player list menu (for managing players and giving lives in multiplayer), and in particular made it work well on a controller again!
Discounted prices and discount labels in the Research Outpost weren't updating correctly after manifesting an item, but now they do!
We also fixed an issue where discounts that applied to X number of items didn't update properly. But now they do!

The tutorial now defaults to showing the trigger rather than a face button as the default Dive button on a controller. The old setup inadvertently told new players that you don't need to bother with the camera while you're diving - which you often do!
Increased default gamepad camera sensitivity to make it feel a little more snappy and responsive without having to dive into the settings menu.

About the change to the Fragment Disruptions: The old version was pretty strong to begin with, and got stronger and stronger the more Sparks you have... so we made them strong in a different way instead! They no longer allow you to manifest a ton of items at very low cost just because you have a lot of Sparks, but on the other hand it's usable beyond the first Research Outpost you visit, if you choose not to use it - or if it's early in a run and you don't have enough Sparks to make use of it. Let us know whether this feels like an improvement!
There's also been some fun stuff happening on the Discord lately! There has been a popularity poll, and the winner- Wait, this can't be right?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/2c3044f18bb06cb843b2fc9e28fccb8266393cd6.png"]
Hello! It's your favourite - everyone's favourite - Captain!
The public has spoken about who they want to hear from, and while I am of course humbled by this honor no one should be surprised by this.

To reward my faithful crew I'm going to add some patch notes. You like items, so now all items are free! However, you cannot aspire to greatness without challenge, so the speed of the Collapse is now 300% faster!
Anyone who starts a Fragment by saying "I need help, Captain!" gets 100% Boost. Sometimes guidance from others is the only way-

Besides, you barely edged out Zoe! And there were lots of other fan favourites in there who deserved to win just as much as you! Ahem.
I should cool off a little.

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"]

We've got a huge update for you today, with new features, new items, and multiplayer improvements. It also brings us one particularly wonderful new face that I'm sure you're going to- Well, I've been told that there's something else I absolutely need to talk about first, so let's get it over with:

Fragments in shard runs now have various modifiers and effects, such as gaining or losing Sparks, gaining Boost or Items, increased difficulty and obstacles, and more! It should make choosing a path on the map much more interesting and give you greater control over what kind of run you have!
You'll now have to think a little bit more about what kind of path you take, depending on what kind of effects you would like or not like, or if you want to pick the prettiest path available to you!
Fragment Disruptions gradually increase over the course of the game, with none in Shard 1, and reach their full potential in Shard 10.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/b1f96d410c17758968a014b785d95ac80df52971.png"]Isn't he just adorable?? I could sit and listen to him play all day long, if not for the fact that I need to be out there looking for items to bring him.

Rest stops now have a new character who will happily accept any item you might offer for donation. This gives you ways of getting rid of unwanted items, and possibly get something more useful in return!
Make sure to pay him a visit! Tell him Riza says hi!

There are now various new items utilising Boost Rings in various ways, allowing for new kinds of builds. There are also a few new Luck-based items to make Luck-based builds more interesting and impactful.
I'm going to let you discover what they are for yourself, but take my word for it - they're a lot of fun!

The Item View now has tooltips explaining what the different item effects actually do in the game! The dev team has decided to include this despite the fact that it will deprive many users on our Discord of their main livelihoods, when people no longer come online to ask what Luck does.
There's a setting to disable it if you don't like the way it looks, or if you already know what everything does. Or if you'd prefer to come and ask on our Discord.
I know how much fun it is to run with friends, so I made sure that the dev team paid some attention to all the suggestions you have been offering!
You can now give another player one of your Lives - as long as you have one to spare! You can do it at any time by using the new interaction in the Player List.
In the Research Outpost you can now also send one of your items to another player, which we're sure you're only going to use to help and support each other. Talk to Dalil to figure it out!
Finally there's also now a setting to have players spawn Boost Rings in their wake, which makes it more beneficial to follow in your friends' footsteps.
It really makes it feel like a cooperative experience now! If it's the end of the world it's better if we're in it together, right?

We have rebalanced the rate at which you get Sparks and the amount of Sparks items cost, so that actually collecting Sparks in levels becomes more impactful. Some of the new items lean into this as well!
I'm not sure how I feel about the dev team meddling with my hard-earned Sparks, but they promise that this is going to make for a more fun game...
Oh, and here's another thing that many many many of you have requested:
Whenever you're offered an item in Endless you can now spend Sparks to reroll your selection. This adds a little more strategy to long-distance Endless runs.

The team has also added a setting for using the new Fragment Disruptions in Endless Mode! Since you don't choose the path yourself, they'll be chosen randomly, but this is for those that want a little extra spice with their snack of Endless.
This one is going to be very important for some of you, so I'll highlight it as well:
There's a new setting in the options to disable some visual distortion filters, which was apparently causing headaches for some players. If that's you, go and switch it off right away!

If all of this seems like a lot, that's because it is! Our testers have helped immensely here and deserve a special shoutout for bringing this leviathan of an update to life. Haste wouldn't be what it is without you!
That brings us to the end of the feature list, but the team has also included a small collection of item changes, a bunch of bug fixes and a few QoL improvements. Check the full list below!
Fragment Disruptions: A new system that makes different Fragments in a Shard have different effects. Choose your path carefully!
The Hungry Weeboh: A new character at Rest Stops that lets you get rid of an unwanted item - and who might offer you something in exchange!
Multiplayer Improvements: Increased cooperation and interactivity.
Reroll Endless items!
Item Effect tooltips: We actually explain most of the core features of the game now!
New items: 9 new items for you to discover, including passing through Boost Rings as a new way of triggering item effects!
Reduced base Spark gain from Fragments by 50%
Decreased Research Outpost item costs by 25%

Slightly reduced the starting Collapse Speed for Shards 8-10, and slightly increased their ending Collapse Speed, meaning that it should be slightly easier to get started and slightly harder to finish.
Item balance is an ongoing concern, so please keep giving us feedback on items that aren't quite living up to expectations, or if you've found fun ways of combining them!

Wingspan now has an increased Cooldown. It's still dangerous, but offers a little bit of grace. Reduced the Cooldown of Steel Hat Lining, hopefully making it more viable as a very intentional protective measure
Increased the Cooldown for Experimental Thrusters
Brittle Breastplate now only does 25 damage instead of 50. Does that make it TOO GOOD? Absolutely not, but now you might actually use it.
Shortcut has increased its duration from 2 to 5 seconds
Boost from Well Earned Confidence increased from 2.5% to 5%
Heir's Determination now also gives +5 Speed (making up for some of the speed usually lost when taking damage)
Blood Engine now gives 8 damage instead of 5, but has its Boost increased to 15% for 6 seconds
Made various improvements to navigating menus with a controller, particularly to the Shard Settings screen
Items in the Research Outpost now show a discount label if their price is reduced
Items from your current run are now displayed on the "Run End" screen
Fixed the description for Experimental Autopilot (yes, we actually did it this time)
The Wobbler Skin now unlocks immediately when the conditions are met so it'll be easier for you to figure out what you got it for
The extra buttons on the main menu (for Credits, Discord and Multiplayer) now disappear correctly when you open the Settings menu
Fixed an issue where the first time you opened the Item View with a controller it would not let you actually inspect the Items you had
It's no longer possible to bring up the Item View while in Interactions or on the Shard Complete screen
Added some missing tags for Items (for random item selection in Encounters)
The Outfit Selection UI can no longer be scrolled horizontally. There wasn't anything to be found there, but that didn't stop some of you from checking.

Fixed getting the Disaster Completed message before actually finishing Disaster Mode. Some of you might get this message for a second time the first time you open this update, but after that it should be fixed!
Fixed Ascension Crowns sometimes not appearing correctly in multiplayer
Fixed some Ascension effects not starting properly in multiplayer for late joiners
Fixed unlocking the next ascension level sometimes not functioning correctly for multiplayer late-joiners
SkinDatabase.GetSkin() now returns the Default skin by... default
Phew, that was a lot! I hope you all enjoy this huge update!

notes.title: Hi again, everyone! You seem to have stayed busy in the one day I've been away. The team has also been busy, so they already have a small patch for you!

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"]

Most importantly, it fixes the problem where mouse users weren't able to buy Abilities from the rest of the crew. Or to back out of the dialogue, either, leaving games locked until you shut it down. Woooops! Anyways, it's all better now, so you can spend your Antisparks to your heart's content!

We also fixed the problem where you would sometimes take damage from passing through the large Agency structure with a... scary burny thing in the middle. Turns out it was some misplaced invisible colliders, and not a clever Agency trap the way I thought... Here's the full list of fixes:
The Ability buying screen buttons now work with mouse input again!,

notes.title: Hello runners! I’m thrilled to present you with a new Haste update - this time we’re bringing you ONLINE MULTIPLAYER CO-OP!

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"]

That’s right! For a while now, the devs have said that multiplayer would be unlikely, but in secret, they’ve spent the last couple of months after release making it possible! (You have no idea how hard it’s been to keep this from you all!) ((Some of you would also say we’ve done a terrible job keeping it secret.))

You can now play through the entire game with other Zoes! It's cooperative in that you work together to progress, but we also keep track of player times in levels, which allows for some friendly and pleasant competition.

You can join friends through Steam's invite system or by using specific join links if you set your room privacy to public. There's no separate mode or anything, you just jump smoothly straight into their game at any point, with every shard and every part of the game playable together! Multiplayer has been designed for up to 4 players. No one will stop you from playing with a whole swarm, but you might need a fast computer and fast internet!

The team has also added skins for Zoe, so it will now be possible to change her outfit and her hat! Skins can be bought with Antisparks from the Fashionable Weeboh, and can be shown off in multiplayer. (I’m thinking of asking for a makeover myself!) There are also special skins that can be unlocked by doing special actions, such as completing the story mode or the first level of Disaster Mode.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/a55d6f2ef4f61c3e25f15a922d592fd0fc93b05a.png"]
Some obstacles have had their art updated, making the Agency more intimidating (and visually and technically consistent).

We've added a chunk of new character interactions, revealing more of their backgrounds and keeping rest stops and coffee breaks fresher for longer! This means you can get to know me and the crew even better!
Added Disaster Mode localisation for Swedish.
Once again increased the chance of getting Coffee Interactions in the research outpost. Hopefully it sticks this time!
Hitting the pillars of one of the big Agency Platform obstacles no longer turns the main platform into an intangible death trap.
Flat Item stat bonuses no longer scale with your metaprogression level for that stat.
Added a missing homage to Flopsy the Lovable Clown
I’m thrilled to share that the dev team has cooked up something extra exciting for this patch!

I’ve been told that some of you are craving an extra layer of challenge in Haste (because apparently the imminent destruction of the entire universe wasn’t enough!) so I think you’ll enjoy what they’ve got in store for you today.
Introducing…
Ta-daa! Trust me, it’s not as scary as it sounds. It’s scarier!!
Disaster Mode is a new game mode that offers the most intense version of Haste yet!
There are 4 distinct levels of difficulty, applied to the Final Shard.
The mode adds new dynamic obstacles, such as burning Lava Flowers and more!
Various new effects are added to increase difficulty.
You need to complete the Final Shard to unlock the first level of Disaster Mode! Then, you can unlock each new level by completing the previous one.
I’m not going to give away all the mode’s secrets here (even though I reeeally want to!) so you’ll need to find out for yourself what each level has in store…
Fixes
Improved Ultrawide support
That’s it for the team’s latest updates, so now it’s time for me to share more of my favourite art from the Discord!
This gorgeous piece is by RocketPotatoL62! I love the colours!!
Ava looks so cool here! This one is by the wonderful Laesu.
Here’s one of Zoe in all her speedy glory!! Created by UpsideDown.
Well, that’s all from me for now!

notes.title: The Haste team is hard at work on some really exciting things, and the first of those things is coming soon! Let's just say it will be a bit of a disaster! (Hm, that sounded a lot better in my head...)

items.text: In the meantime, I'm here with a small update for you with some balance changes, bug fixes and quality of life improvements.
Oh, there's now an option to restart a Shard Run directly without stopping by the Hub World! This should be a very welcome addition for a lot of players.
Simply choose "Abandon Shard" and you'll get the choice between restarting or going back to the Hub World. Be careful, though! You won't earn Antisparks if you do a quick restart.

The team has tweaked the difficulty of the Shards quite a bit, to make the difficulty of each Shard more of a curve. Personally, I think they have really improved the pattern, so that most Shards are now a little easier when you start a run (and have no items), but are harder towards the end when you hopefully have a little more item support with you!

I have also seen a lot of comments about a "Snake" out there on runs. I've never seen it, so I don't really understand what people are complaining about. Meeting a snake sounds like it would be cute! Anyways, see if you like it better now!
There were how many lines missing in other languages than English??? Anyways, they should mostly be in now... 😄
timeline refactor... energy gain rate... save swapping...
I don't even know what half of these words mean!
QoL

Added a Reset Shard option! When you choose "Abandon Shard" you can now choose between returning to the Hub World or restarting your current Shard with the same settings. To everyone who already completed "The Machine": we're deeply sorry.,
Endless music now changes when the track ends, not immediately every 3 levels. Hope this better protects your sanity on those really long runs!,
Added a setting to "Invert Look X-axis",
Added a cool-looking opening screen to Shard Runs (This will make a lot of sense in the near future...........),
Balance
Balance changes to a number of Shards. They were too hard at the start and too easy by the end!,
Slightly reduced the damage from Black Hole Rocks and the Glow Thing in Void Fragments,,
Reduced the damage of Snake's beam explosions by 20%,
Fixes
Added a bunch of missing localization for other languages than English,
Timeline Refactor now also rewinds the End boss final machine timer,
Rest Area and Shop: Dying immediately and losing one or more lives, and also skipping other levels, should not happen anymore,
Items affecting Energy Gain Rate no longer affect energy usage rate (Wait, they did what??),
Brittle Breastplate now triggers health loss on Bad landings too, not just Ok landings, since it was obviously hugely overpowered and desperately needed a nerf...,

Fixed an issue where you would keep your items when saving and quitting to the main menu, then immediately swapping to and starting another save slot, where that new save slot does not have a run active (i.e. it's a new save slot, or you're in the hub world),

releases.displayName: Haste Patch: Addressing your Feedback + Animated Trailer!

items.text: We’re seeing your feedback and we’re listening!
Haste is too hard - we’re making some tweaks to fix that in this first patch.

The team and our testers have been playing this game for three years and have lost sight of what it would feel like to play for the first time. We’re rectifying this now based on your brilliant feedback.
We also have more tweaks coming in the future!
(If you enjoy the game being really hard, don’t worry, we have something coming for you as well.)
Increased starting life from 2 to 3
All items are cheaper
Reduced the number of obstacles in fragments
Player gets more Antisparks
First tier of Antisparks upgrades are now cheaper
In general, made items that give Sparks give more Sparks
Made encounter challenges less common
Made some really hard obstacles less common
Made versions 2 and 3 of the Jumper boss easier
Added a re-roll option in the shop
Keep running mode now gets harder quicker
Increased the frequency of shops
Encounter challenges now don't take a life when you fail them (you can still die normally in them)
You now cycle through all (valid) Challenges before you get one you've had before
Captain will now always unlock before the end of shard 1
Rebalanced the Sage's Cowl to make it more useful
Added ability to abandon run in level select
Fixed portal in the shop not showing up
Fixed issue where you no longer could talk to The Captain after getting the hourglass
Fixed some obstacles not being harpoonable
Fixed "On enter Fragment" items not triggering in bosses and the challenges
Fixed language bugs
Fixes bugs with statistics
Fixed issues with Endless Shard text formatting in some languages
Fixed text in all languages
Fixed some items not being shown when talking to the Researcher
Fixed some issues with the Sage's Cowl not working even though you had the energy for it
Fixed issues with dying while going into the portal
Fixed ability unlocks not working with controller
We also just released the animated trailer for the game!
